items.label: Excellent Durability & Stability
items.value: Made of high-quality PE rattan and steel, this patio furniture set has strong toughness and superior load-bearing performance, which is not easy to break after long time use. Both table and chairs are equipped with anti-skid foot mats, which enhance the overall stability while prevent scratching the floor.

items.label: Upgraded Comfort Experience
items.value: Equipped with soft and breathable sponge cushions, this furniture set will provide you with extraordinary comfort experience. Ergonomic backrest and armrests allow your body to lean and stretch naturally, so that you can relieve your fatigue of the day and fully enjoy leisure time.

items.label: Easy Assembly & Cleaning
items.value: All the components and detailed instruction are included so that you can easily and quickly assemble the patio sofa set. Seat cushions are designed with removable covers for easy washing and maintenance, and you can easily wipe the tempered glass tabletop with just a damp cloth when there are stains on it.

items.label: Wide Range of Applications
items.value: Made of all-weather PE rattan, this 3-piece wicker furniture set is suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. With Simple and generous appearance, it is ideal for patio, front porch, poolside, backyard and many other spaces.

items.label: Dimension of Patio Conversation Set
items.value: Chair: 26" x 28" x 29" (L x W x H), coffee table: 17.5" x 17.5" x 17" (L x W x H), weight capacity of chair: 350 lbs, weight capacity of coffee table: 110 lbs.

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Coffee Table, 1 x Instruction, 2 x Back Cushion, 2 x Seat Cushion, 2 x Wicker Chair

items.value: Assembly is required and instructions are included.
